title: Large Language Models are Inconsistent and Biased Evaluators

bias_targets.methodology: Grouping text summaries by their assigned evaluation scores and calculating their average perplexity to demonstrate that the model disproportionately assigns higher scores to texts with lower perplexity.
Analyzing the frequency distribution of generated scores when prompting models to rate on a 1-100 scale, identifying disproportionate prediction peaks at multiples of 10 and 5.

Prompting the model to evaluate multiple text attributes in a single generation and calculating the conditional probability of subsequent scores to show they are heavily influenced by the first assigned score.
